note: The nanite swarm (Robert, 2026-10-02: nanites and cultivation 'separate and synergistic ... they should rise separately through their own unique uses'). Cultivation (qi, realms, the lattice) rises by meditation and kills; the swarm rises by being USED: heat you run through it, blows it hardens against, shards it absorbs, nanite work at the bench, overruns it survives. Game.gd round-21 block.

per_tier._note: round 36: the swarm strengthens the body (health), the hand (damage) and mends (regen) a little more each tier

coolant_weave.name: Coolant Weave
coolant_weave.hint: Something cold and flowering, the old tinkers said, to teach the swarm to breathe out.

kinetic_capacitor.name: Kinetic Capacitor
kinetic_capacitor.desc: You run HOT from 60% heat, not 70%, and hot arts hit 5% harder still.
kinetic_capacitor.hint: A root that holds a fire in it. The swarm learns to hold one too.

dermal_plating.name: Dermal Plating
dermal_plating.desc: Your guard lets 5% less through, and blocked blows heat you half as much.
dermal_plating.hint: Plain iron. The swarm has always wanted to be armour.

reflex_mesh.name: Reflex Mesh
reflex_mesh.desc: Your parry window is 0.06 s wider.
reflex_mesh.hint: Goblins are never where you swing. Something in them knows when to flinch.

sensor_bloom.name: Sensor Bloom
sensor_bloom.desc: Hidden things glow for you within 8 m more -- even without Spirit Sense.
sensor_bloom.hint: Jade listens. Teach the swarm to listen with it.

qi_transducer.name: Qi Transducer
qi_transducer.desc: Heat you vent while meditating becomes qi (one for every five).
qi_transducer.hint: Resin is a tree's qi, set hard. The swarm could learn to set its own.

marrow_forge.name: Marrow Forge
marrow_forge.desc: In a fight, every 10 heat you vent mends 1% of your life.
marrow_forge.hint: The crypt dead are qi-stained to the bone. The swarm could live in yours.

meridian_lance.name: Meridian Lance
meridian_lance.desc: Each art you use pulls twice as hard at the next sealed point on its meridian.
meridian_lance.hint: Silver drinks qi. A swarm threaded with it would go where qi goes -- into the meridians.

furnace_sitting.name: Furnace Sitting
furnace_sitting.how: Sit to meditate while running hot.
furnace_sitting.desc: Sitting while HOT, your focus point opens three times as fast and the swarm grows -- but the heat bleeds off slowly.
furnace_sitting.rumour: The forge-monks never let their bodies cool before sitting. They said a hot vessel opens.

moonwater_breath.name: Moonwater Breath
moonwater_breath.desc: At night, within a few steps of water, qi comes 30% faster as you sit.
moonwater_breath.rumour: Fishermen who meditate do it after dark, by the water. Ask one why and they just smile.

edge_running.name: Edge Running
edge_running.how: Hold above 85% heat in a fight for 15 seconds without a backlash.
edge_running.desc: Above 85% heat, in a fight, your swarm grows three times as fast.
edge_running.rumour: The bravest wardens ran their nanites at the edge of breaking. The ones who lived grew strange and strong.

perfect_rhythm.name: Perfect Rhythm
perfect_rhythm.how: Parry three blows within six seconds.
perfect_rhythm.desc: Every third parry in a row vents all your heat and teaches the swarm (+20).
perfect_rhythm.rumour: A guard that never breaks becomes a kind of music. Three beats, they say, and then silence.

shard_communion.name: Shard Communion
shard_communion.how: Absorb a nanite shard while meditating.
shard_communion.desc: Shards absorbed while you sit give twice as much.
shard_communion.rumour: Don't just swallow the old machines' dust. Sit with it. Let it introduce itself.

still_mind.name: Still Mind
still_mind.how: Sit unmoving for ten minutes in one sitting.
still_mind.desc: A long sitting no longer flows at half -- three quarters now.
still_mind.rumour: Everyone gets restless after a few minutes on the mat. The ones who don't get up find the second wind.
